# Pull Request

## What did you change?

Briefly describe the programs, tasks, answers, or documentation you added or improved.

## Type of change

- [ ] New program
- [ ] Practice task
- [ ] Answer code
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Formatting or spelling fix

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the example simple and beginner-friendly.
- [ ] I used clear file names.
- [ ] I tested the program, if code was changed.
- [ ] I followed the existing folder style.
